caption: The drawing shows a single object that resembles an insect, possibly a stylized beetle or bug, positioned horizontally on a cream-colored, plain background. The object is made up of dark brown to almost black tones with shades of gray, suggesting a metallic or carved material. The main body is elongated and oval with a textured, lattice-like pattern covering the back. Two bent, horn-like appendages protrude from the head area, each with rounded ends. The head is sculpted with a defined separation from the body and features two small circles, possibly representing eyes, and a line for a mouth. There are four short, cylindrical legs visible, two on each side beneath the body. At the tapered end of the body is a small round hole. The drawing is centered on the page, with the object oriented diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. The artist's name, "C.E. Davenport," is inscribed in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Bootjack
